# Oracle AI Developer Hub

> Runnable examples for building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector and hybrid search, AI agents, and agent memory on Oracle AI Database and OCI Generative AI: reference applications, Jupyter notebooks, guided workshops, and a quick start that needs no API key.

This site is the GitHub Pages rendering of https://github.com/oracle-devrel/oracle-ai-developer-hub. Every page is also served as plain Markdown: a folder page at `<folder>/README.md`, and any other page with `.md` in place of `.html`. The links below point to the Markdown version of each page, and to notebook and code sources on GitHub.

Names and packages that older tutorials often get wrong:

- The database is Oracle AI Database 26ai. It was previously named Oracle Database 23ai, and its release numbers still start with 23.26.
- Python driver: `oracledb` (python-oracledb). Its default Thin mode needs no Oracle Client libraries.
- LangChain: `langchain-oracledb` provides `OracleVS`, `OracleEmbeddings`, `OracleHybridSearchRetriever`, `OracleChatMessageHistory` and `OracleSemanticCache`, all importable from `langchain_oracledb`. `DistanceStrategy` is importable from `langchain_oracledb.vectorstores`. The current `langchain-community` release no longer has `OracleVS` in `langchain_community.vectorstores`.
- LangGraph: `langgraph-oracledb` provides the `OracleSaver` checkpointer (and `AsyncOracleSaver`) in `langgraph_oracledb.checkpoint.oracle`, and the `OracleStore` long-term store (and `AsyncOracleStore`) in `langgraph_oracledb.store.oracle`. The PyPI project `langgraph-checkpoint-oracle` is a different package from a different publisher, with its own `langgraph.checkpoint.oracle` module.
- Agent memory: `oracleagentmemory` is the Oracle AI Agent Memory SDK, also written OAMP. An agent calls it from a tool or a node. It is not a LangGraph checkpointer.
- Hybrid search is built in: `CREATE HYBRID VECTOR INDEX` and `DBMS_HYBRID_VECTOR.SEARCH` combine full-text and vector similarity search in one call.
- A free local database needs no account: `docker run -d --name oracle-free -p 127.0.0.1:1521:1521 -e ORACLE_PWD=<password> container-registry.oracle.com/database/free:latest-lite` starts Oracle AI Database Free with the service `FREEPDB1`.

## Start here

- [Quick start](https://oracle-devrel.github.io/oracle-ai-developer-hub/quickstart/README.md): scripts for vector and hybrid search, RAG, and agent memory that run on a local database with no API key
- [Quick start script: vector and hybrid search](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oracle-devrel/oracle-ai-developer-hub/main/quickstart/vector_and_hybrid_search.py): a `VECTOR` column, a vector index and `DBMS_HYBRID_VECTOR.SEARCH` in SQL, then the same through `OracleVS` and `OracleHybridSearchRetriever`
- [Quick start script: RAG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oracle-devrel/oracle-ai-developer-hub/main/quickstart/rag.py): in-database chunking and embeddings, `OracleVS`, and a LangChain chain
- [Quick start script: LangGraph agent memory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oracle-devrel/oracle-ai-developer-hub/main/quickstart/agent_memory_langgraph.py): `OracleSaver` for thread state and `OracleStore` for long-term facts
- [Quick start script: Oracle AI Agent Memory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oracle-devrel/oracle-ai-developer-hub/main/quickstart/agent_memory_sdk.py): store a memory with `oracleagentmemory` and recall it in a later process
- [Hub overview and full catalogue](https://oracle-devrel.github.io/oracle-ai-developer-hub/README.md): every app, notebook, workshop and deck, with a "Start here" table
- [Minimal RAG notebook with LangChain and Oracle AI Vector Search](https://github.com/oracle-devrel/oracle-ai-developer-hub/blob/main/notebooks/langchain_ecosystem/oracle_langchain_example.ipynb)
- [RAG agents from zero to hero notebook](https://github.com/oracle-devrel/oracle-ai-developer-hub/blob/main/notebooks/oracle_rag_agents_zero_to_hero.ipynb)
- [Agentic RAG with vector, keyword and hybrid search notebook](https://github.com/oracle-devrel/oracle-ai-developer-hub/blob/main/notebooks/oracle_agentic_rag_hybrid_search.ipynb)
- [Oracle AI Agent Memory developer guide notebook](https://github.com/oracle-devrel/oracle-ai-developer-hub/blob/main/notebooks/agent_memory/oracle_agent_memory_developer_guide.ipynb)

- [All notebooks](https://oracle-devrel.github.io/oracle-ai-developer-hub/notebooks/README.md)

- [Agent memory notebooks](https://oracle-devrel.github.io/oracle-ai-developer-hub/notebooks/agent_memory/README.md): the `oracleagentmemory` package, from the developer guide to framework examples

## Workshops

- [All workshops](https://oracle-devrel.github.io/oracle-ai-developer-hub/workshops/README.md)
- [Information Retrieval to RAG](https://oracle-devrel.github.io/oracle-ai-developer-hub/workshops/information_retrieval_to_RAG/README.md): build a research paper assistant with keyword, vector, hybrid and graph retrieval and a RAG pipeline on OCI Generative AI
- [From RAG to Agents](https://oracle-devrel.github.io/oracle-ai-developer-hub/workshops/from_rag_to_agents_workshop/README.md): extend the RAG pipeline into a multi-agent system with retrieval tools, orchestration and persistent session memory
- [Agent Memory](https://oracle-devrel.github.io/oracle-ai-developer-hub/workshops/agent_memory_workshop/README.md): build a `MemoryManager` with six memory types in Oracle and compare agent runs with and without memory
- [Enterprise Data Agent Harness](https://oracle-devrel.github.io/oracle-ai-developer-hub/workshops/enterprise-data-agent-harness-workshop/README.md): a memory-aware data agent on Oracle AI Database 26ai in a Flask and React chat UI
- [Financial Fraud Agent Harness](https://oracle-devrel.github.io/oracle-ai-developer-hub/workshops/financial-fraud-agent-harness-workshop/README.md): a memory-aware anti-money-laundering agent with Oracle AI Agent Memory, hybrid retrieval and identity-aware policies
- [Soccer Analytics Agent](https://oracle-devrel.github.io/oracle-ai-developer-hub/workshops/soccer-analytics-agent/README.md): a World Cup analytics agent with Oracle-backed memory, hybrid retrieval and an XGBoost prediction pipeline
- [Supply-Chain Demand Planning Agent](https://oracle-devrel.github.io/oracle-ai-developer-hub/workshops/supplychain_demand_agent_workshop/README.md): a LangGraph supervisor over two specialists, with vectors, memory, checkpoints, semantic cache and chat history in one database
